comments.author: Dazzuh
comments.body_html:
I was getting this error as well. somehow it’s detecting a profile that doesn’t have the ‘skills’ field and this error occurs. I worked around it by adding the following to the setBotSound function:

if (!skills || !skills.Common) { return } so it should look like this:

// Find BotSound skill in the list of skills and change it’s value private setBotSound(skills: Skills): void { if (!skills || !skills.Common) { return } const common = skills.Common const BotSoundSkill = common.find(o => o.Id === ‘BotSound’); if (BotSoundSkill) { BotSoundSkill.Progress = this.value; } return skills } This is a pretty lazy fix and I didn’t look into it further than this but it seems to have fixed it for me, works in-game too.

fwiw I’m using Fika with a fika dedicated profile and I suspect that might be related.

Edit: Actually RagingBeardos explanation makes more sense, I also have a profile that hasn’t been fully created yet.
